RESOLVED: Dear Dana, 

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for brain MRI on August 27

Thank you for reaching out to us about your denied claim. I've reviewed your case and confirmed that the denial reason was "prior authorization not on file". I understand that your doctor ordered the MRI for your migraines, and I'm here to help you with the next steps.

You have the right to appeal this decision within 180 days of the denial notice date. Since the denial notice was sent on September 5, your appeal deadline is March 4, 2027. To initiate the appeal process, please find attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) that you can complete and return to us.

Your ordering provider, Dr. L. Okonjo, may also submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity. If you have any questions or need assistance with the appeal process, please don't hesitate to reach out to me directly.

Please note that standard appeals are decided within 30 calendar days. I'll ensure that your appeal is processed promptly, and you'll receive a decision in writing.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please feel free to contact me. Your health and well-being are our top priority, and I'm here to support you throughout this process.

Best regards,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan Member Services
